_readme: Hand corrections to the DKTech catalogue. Edit this file on github.com and commit; the site rebuilds by itself.

add: a track that is in neither the release master nor Spotify. Needs isrc and title. Optional fields: artists, collaborators, labels, distributors, releaseDate (YYYY-MM-DD), release, catalogNumber, upc, trackNumber, durationSeconds, genre, writers, isrcs (every code of the row, including isrc), source.

override: fix fields of a row that already exists, keyed by an ISRC only that row carries. The value written here always wins over the master and Spotify. isrcs replaces the row's code list; null clears release, catalogNumber, upc, trackNumber, durationSeconds, genre, writers or releaseDate.
source: where the correction comes from, shown with the row on the catalogue page. resolved: true clears the row's review flags because the source settles them.
hide: ISRC codes that must not appear on the site.
Example for override: {"GBKQU2672241": {"labels": ["Resilient Recordings"], "source": "the label's release sheet"}}
A mistake in this file (an unknown field, a date in the wrong form, a key two rows carry) stops the build with a message naming it, so the live site stays as it was.
